title: Classify bounded European dynamic raw transfer producers
changes: Trace the dynamic raw transfer setter and classify explicitly supplied selectors 7, 8 and 9 without inventing a global index bound.
validation: Static exact-ROM inspection authenticates 24 direct setter calls, six literal selector calls, two live-byte callers and the task transition/transfer instructions. Six four-byte rows and five 256-byte candidate bank fragments total 1304 bytes and do not overlap the 84 e93 manifest resources; 87 guarded files remain unchanged.
limitations: The source inspection does not prove ordinary dynamic-path execution, global bounds, full ABI, other indices or a new managed runtime owner. Two callers obtain an unconstrained live byte; helper/task-state gates remain active.
No build, guest replay, performance measurement or old proof repeated; new Linux and USA verification remain pending.
